record_notes.DCP-LETT-1814: January 2, conjectured 1856 from 1855 watermark. Three full blocks, seven notes and bibliography read. Friendly Herbert letter received but poetry volume still at Athenaeum awaiting collection; future pleasure not completed reading. Unidentified current book must not become Mary Anne Herbert’s 1877 posthumous poems. An earlier Darwin letter was begun, interrupted and destroyed, not an extant prompt or sent letter. Old correspondence reread months ago, Barmouth reminiscence and inability to visit remain distinct stages. Health claim never leaves home is rhetorical current self-report, not a literal lifetime itinerary.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2020A: November 18, supplied 1856 from Emma pregnancy and Blakiston expedition. Six blocks and six notes read. Missing Herbert request for Blakiston interview; Darwin cannot host or travel now, offers mid-January London meeting or written suggestions after learning scientific interests. January 13–16 actual later stay and December 6 birth are editorial dating evidence, not completed November events. General Admiralty geology instructions already exist. P6 after closing authorizes possible forwarding; no proof forwarded or met. Palliser North American expedition is distinct from Austrian expedition elsewhere.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1614: December 18, 1857 despite lower catalogue number; eleven blocks, four footnotes, full annotations and bibliography read. Eight-page Hewitt ALS answers missing Darwin query after illness/bereavement. Twelve pairs and male-pheasant trials are Hewitt past experiments; Sebright cock/female pheasant singleton is friend report, reverse sexes not his own matched experiment. Rose comb/wattles, nostrils, immature colour and smaller size described with future plumage predictions. Hundreds of opened embryo eggs differ from single eleven-egg complete hatch, followed by predation/accident deaths before maturity; do not label these intrinsic sterility. Sex inference by size and eventual pubication plans qualified. P9 liberty/cross insertion was Hewitt authorial addition placed by cross, not Darwin margin or editor prose; preserve logical insertion. Undated Darwin markings not an exact receipt date.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2193: December 22,1857, seven full blocks, seven notes, annotations and bibliography read. Answers a newly received but missing Darwin response and explicitly refers to December18 former note, giving indirect evidence earlier content reached Darwin; no surviving dated Darwin answer. More than300 eggs in a trial year and fewer than12 hatched are recollections without diary; separate55 eggs/3 hens cross and single Sebright hybrid are different samples, not one denominator. Opposite-sex cross failures, clear eggs versus embryos, seasonal effect and not24-ounce hybrid preserve distinctions. Spur/violence claims observational and generalization-limited, youth caveat for docility. No sexual attempts observed is bounded observation, not every hybrid universally infertile. Later Natural selection/Origin use and undated markings do not date first receipt.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2038: January10,1857, ten full blocks, seven notes, complete annotations and bibliography read. Hill receives missing Darwin communication by early December packet. Cithagra breeding refusal is through Shakspear reporting Leyden; suspected false wild-canary identification remains tentative. Chitty shell collection is already presented at British Museum in body, contrary to future-tense editorial summary. Hurricane/duck-egg dispersal assertions mix observations, records and inference; own waterspout sighting differs from reported Haitian frogs and Saint Vincent boa. Hibiscus diffusion asserted, current pamphlet dispatch announced, migratory-bird paper future and unlocated. P10 Darwin address appended to closing is not body prose. Darwin tropical-fish marginal question undated and deleted, not an answer to train.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2064: March12,1857, fourteen full blocks, five notes, complete annotations and bibliography read. Missing new Darwin letter acknowledged; explicitly retreats from prior duck-mediated crustacean certainty to common report, doubts ova survive gizzard, promises precise evidence. This is no definitive experiment or disproof. Anas maxima example combines sister’s1848 storm bird with recent friend-reported specimens; possible hybrid identification and alleged death cause remain attributed, not proven physiology. Seeds going uphill in cattle dung differ from river downstream transport; Spanish introductions and essential-germination claims are Hill reports/hypotheses. Mullets taking seeds not evidence seeds survived fish digestion. Whistling-duck breeding observed, Palamedea rearing/pairing not proven breeding, parrot negative report and quail enclosure/blindness claims bounded. Later promises not delivered. Raw43o degree and vegeation/other spelling artifacts require supported rendering. Undated Darwin annotation expressly says ducks carrying eggs not known.

Photography expense entries July/December1857 suggest lower range but not particular order; annual Baxter payment means those costs unlikely his bills. Requests tomorrow one quart distilled water, not receipt. P3 Down/Saturday is embedded dateline excluded from final content. F does not establish fragment status.

reading_method: Root independently read complete surviving new source bodies, metadata constraints, exclusions, footnotes, scholarly sections and bibliography. Actual special markup and figures inspected where present. Reused explicit accepted primary readings only after matching source and accepted evidence hashes. Historical decisions and notes are handwritten; validation packages evidence rather than adjudicating it.
